name: Macaron
message: 「Surely big brother isn't coming today, right...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「While I have the chance, time for some warm yummy food...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord. Do ya really gotta go out on a day like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「A little rain like this isn't going to stop how I feel」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, I want to talk to Macaron as soon as possible」

name: Synn
message: 「I want the two of us to properly think things through about the Demon Lord」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, forget that, I just can't stand my body getting all damp...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll make sure to air you out properly on a nice sunny day」

name: Paqy
message: 「Being treated like that feels kinda weird too...」
The instant our eyes meet, she spins on her heel at Mach speed.
After an awkward headfirst slide, she sinks into a puddle and doesn't move.
I rush over in a panic and help her up.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? N-no, I didn't touch your boobs or anything!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「That was a sneer, okay. Because you're just way too stupid, big brother」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I thought you were feeling even more down」

name: Macaron
message: 「And whose fault is it that I ended up like that?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I told you not to apologize. It just makes me look pathetic」
Trying to stand up, she raises her body.
I feel like if I just let her go like this, I'll never be able to touch her again...
I pulled her slender shoulders tightly into my embrace.
Right now, that's the only thing I can do.

name: Synn
message: 「As long as I can be with you, Macaron.」
While wrapped in the cold rain.
With the image of dragging up a torrent of power from the depths of my soul.
With breathing as if holding back a swelling excitement.
I unleash the power in my hands.

name: Macaron
message: 「What is it... Are you trying to show off...」

name: Synn
message: 「I have the power of the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Power that doesn't lose even to yours, Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「This power I inherited from Dad, the previous Demon Lord, is the real deal」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know what to do with this power」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know how to use this power」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, is this the kind of Demon Lord you were aiming to be, Macaron?」

name: Synn
message: 「A spineless Demon Lord who just has power and can't do anything with it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「The Demon Lord I looked up to was way more amazing than that」

name: Macaron
message: 「Kind, trusted, and always there to help when people are in trouble--everyone's hero」

name: Synn
message: 「...See, Macaron? You already have a wonderful ideal of your own」

name: Synn
message: 「You've worked hard to live up to it, and everyone's come to recognize you for it」

name: Synn
message: 「I've known you were a kind girl ever since the very first time we met, Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「Even the folks in the shopping district trust you, and you helped Lolotte and the others make up」

name: Synn
message: 「You even win Demon Generals over to your side, and us in the Student Council are already your allies too」

name: Synn
message: 「Every bit of effort you've put in has brought you closer to becoming the Demon Lord, hasn't it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't have power like yours, Big Brother...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll become the strength you're looking for, Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「And in return, I want you to teach me the ambitions of a Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「That way, the two of us can aim to become Demon Lords together」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't ever lie to you again, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「Are we... going to be together forever from now on...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, um, how should I put it...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Are you really okay with that, Big Brother?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Why would you do all this for someone like me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I thought if I did, we could stay together forever」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's it! That's what I'm asking why about...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, you surprised me so much I couldn't even hear what you said... 」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Hey, I said I didn't hear you... 」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, you know, um... you can tell, right!」

name: Macaron
message: 「The big brother who accepts me, supports me, and watches over me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「So much that I want to hug you tight like this and never let go... I really, truly love you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Looks like I actually had the courage...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sticking this close together, there's no way we'll be separated」
Like gentle pecks, neither too close nor too far.
Confirming the distance between each other.
Sweetly melting together from the kiss, the two of us become one.

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe... If we're not at least this close...」
Because we're already a single existence now.
More than the bond of the Demon Lord, we're tied together by our feelings of love.

name: Macaron
message: 「Only if you let go of me, Big Brother」
I hurriedly put some distance between us.
Somehow, it actually makes me feel kind of embarrassed.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... we need to head back and change」

name: Macaron
message: 「Before that, Big Brother, what about that look of yours」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe. You look cool even like that, though」
If that's the case, maybe the Demon Lord's power isn't so bad after all.
As long as it gives me the strength to support Macaron's ideals...

name: Sengen'in
message: 「So that is the form of the Demon Lord...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Synn Sakura... I thought something was up, and I see how it is...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I sensed a sudden surge of magic power and came to see what was going on, and...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「To think I'd run into the legendary Demon Lord」

name: Soltia
message: 「I am Soltia, one of the Seven Demon Generals」

name: Soltia
message: 「One who desires the fulfillment of Re-Crea and the elimination of the Demon Lord who stands in its way」

name: Macaron
message: 「You were the one controlling Bylous, Pasta-chan, and the other Demons?」

name: Soltia
message: 「After all, you're going to vanish cleanly right here」

name: Soltia
message: 「There's no need for you to know, is there?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Hehe... From the looks of it, you're still incomplete as the Demon Lord」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even I alone am more than enough to obliterate you」

name: Synn
message: 「...It's true that on our own, we might still be incomplete」

name: Macaron
message: 「But together, the two of us are the Demon Lord......」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's because we're together that we're the Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「As long as we're together, we won't lose to anyone!」

name: Soltia
message: 「I myself will wipe you out without leaving a trace!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Now, try to struggle a little for me......!」
